meta.title: Our houses
meta.description: Two courtyard houses — Al-Balad in Jeddah and Wadi Hanifah in Riyadh — with live opening hours, directions, parking and access.

locations.title: Two courtyards, one clock
locations.intro: Both houses keep the same hours and the same menus. The light is different: Jeddah’s sun sets some twenty minutes after Riyadh’s.

meta.title: Contact
meta.description: Write to Zill — bookings, gatherings, private dining, press and anything else. We reply within one working day.

contact.title: Write to the house
contact.intro: We read every message and reply within one working day. For a table tonight, calling the house is quicker.
contact.subject: What is it about?
contact.privateHint: For private dining and catering, the private dining page has a form with everything we need to quote.

meta.title: Careers
meta.description: Open positions in the kitchens and dining rooms of Zill, in Jeddah and Riyadh.

careers.title: Join the houses
careers.intro: We are a small team in two houses. We look for people who notice things — the light, the temperature of a room, the moment a guest needs nothing more.
careers.none: No positions are open right now. Send us a note anyway at the address below; we keep it for the next opening.
careers.applyIntro: Tell us a little about yourself and attach your CV. We reply to every application within two weeks.
careers.cvHint: PDF or Word, up to 5 MB.
careers.done: Thank you — your application is with us. A copy is on its way to {email}.

meta.title: The seasonal letter
meta.description: Four letters a year: what has come into season, the gatherings ahead, and a recipe from the kitchen.

newsletter.title: A letter at the change of season
newsletter.intro: Four times a year, never more: what has come into season, the gatherings ahead, and a recipe from the kitchen.
newsletter.promise: We never share your address, and every letter has a one-click way out.
